clauses.reason: EO6589 replaces section 7 of EO3434 as amended by EO5298. It continues the parent as amended: extension to listed governmental vehicles with the section 5 license-fee exception, and independent proviso permitting the Governor to authorize free official passenger automobile licenses for legations. The amendment is not exhausted merely by its promulgation. Neither parent text, section 5, prior amendment nor a later extinguishing provision is held in this dossier. No held evidence establishes first cessation, current operative predicate or disposition of licenses already issued. Neither Canal Zone historical change nor provisional NO can fill those gaps.
